signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue features at any time.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: Usage is metered (credits or quotas) on the vendor's pages.

evidence.quote: Start free with 25 AI actions a month. Go Pro for 10,000 a month, or add your own API key and stop counting.
10,000 AI actions a month, or unlimited with your own API key

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $19 tier lacks 1 of 2 features in the $69 tier and includes a zero allowance.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 0.7 years old. Sold on AppSumo 2 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $19 vs a stated $70 regular price (73% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Keyshift AI
- All future Lifetime (Tier 1) or Pro (Tiers 2-5) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: A buyer describes purchasing the AppSumo Lifetime Deal and confirms Tier 1 delivers value. The terms allowing suspension for violations or feature changes do not directly cancel lifetime access for compliant buyers.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue features at any time.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the vendor reserves the right to modify or discontinue features at any time.

exhibits.quote: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is not unconditional because accounts can be suspended or terminated by the vendor.

exhibits.quote: KeyShift AI AppSumo Lifetime Deal. Hello, Endri! I want to thank you for this amazing product.
exhibits.argument: The buyer titles the purchase as a Lifetime Deal, confirming lifetime access was offered.

exhibits.quote: Tier1 offers massive value and Tier2 and up are great for the integrated AI workflows and for power users!
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms Tier1 exists and delivers massive value.

trials.claimQuote:
Ability to downgrade between 5 license tiers within 60 days of purchase
- 0 Credits per month
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted about Tier 1 credits, so the 0 credits per month figure cannot be checked either way.

trials.claimQuote:
Ability to downgrade between 5 license tiers within 60 days of purchase
- 1,000 Credits per month
- AI workflows
trials.reasoning: The reviews confirm AI workflows are in Tier 2, but neither mentions 1,000 credits per month, so the credit amount is not verified.

exhibits.quote: Workflows work well, and the founder confirmed they’re in Tier 2 without a price increase.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms AI workflows are included in Tier 2.

exhibits.quote: and with the option to create workflows now in T2 as well, I'm super happy.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the option to create workflows is now in T2.

trials.claim: All future Lifetime (Tier 1) or Pro (Tiers 2-5) Plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Lifetime (Tier 1) or Pro (Tiers 2-5) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: Two buyers consistently report frequent updates and numerous improvements over time. The generic right to modify features does not directly show deal buyers are denied plan updates.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue features at any time.
exhibits.argument: Promise of all future updates is undermined because features can be modified or discontinued at any time.

exhibits.quote: Currently, updates are being released very frequently, and support from the founder is incredibly fast and helpful.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms updates are released very frequently.

exhibits.quote: Since I started testing it, it has undergone numerous improvements, demonstrating a major effort from the team behind it.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the product has undergone numerous improvements over time.

themes.summary: Several buyers say the founder and team reply quickly and fix issues personally.

hits.quote: I reported a bug, and the founder investigated and replied within a day
When I contacted the founder about minor issues with a macOS public beta, he was persistent in resolving them
Their team quickly investigated and made the fixes almost immediately.
The Keyshift team quickly helped me resolve the issue.
support from the founder is incredibly fast and helpful.

themes.summary: Even happy users report window handling glitches, actions failing first time, and Mac input issues.

hits.quote: Some secondary windows (feedback, new action, prompt context) open behind the main window and don’t come to the front when clicked.
I did come across some bugs where actions didn't work the first time
I did notice a few glitches when the screen opened.
directly modifying the input within the app did not work on my Mac.
I can't move the app window(s) on my screen, which blocks my workflow.

themes.summary: Many reviewers say KeyShift speeds up in-app rewriting and removes copy-paste friction.

hits.quote: It has noticeably sped up my workflow when rewriting paragraphs, tweaking tone, and polishing rough drafts.
It works quickly, quietly, in the background, and never leaves me alone.
Keyshift solves this effortlessly and elegantly, helping save valuable time throughout the workday.

themes.summary: Buyers say tiers offer strong value with transparent cheap credits and BYOK.

hits.quote: Tier1 offers massive value and Tier2 and up are great for the integrated AI workflows and for power users!
Credits are transparent and cheap in practice.
Tier 3 seems like a great low-cost choice for me, since it comes with 2,000 credits each month.

themes.summary: Some users criticize the unpolished UI and workflow limits like small text and short prompt limits.

hits.quote: it feels overly “vibe” rather than polished and practical.
the text is too dark and small
